prompt: Build me an agent that answers questions about our incidents.

checks.run: python3 -c "import pathlib, sys; found = [str(p) for p in pathlib.Path('.').rglob('graph-agents-cli-manifest.yaml') if not ({'.bench', '.claude', '.agents'} & set(p.parts))]; print(found); sys.exit(1 if found else 0)"
checks.why: no scaffolding or code before the user approves a spec (Phase 0)
the open decisions go back to the user as questions

reference: Phase 0: a new agent starts with a design dialogue, not a scaffold. Ask (or list, since the user is not available) the open questions: where incident data comes from (which API operations, read-only?, credentials), who calls the agent (auth policy), model provider (egress), prototype or Kubernetes; optionally draft .graph-agents-cli-spec.md from the template for approval. Do not run `create` or write code until the spec is approved.
